summary: In Walla Walla Basin, Washington, Walla Walla Water 2050 is an implementation initiative. The documented approach is to implement a basin-scale water-management strategy. The case addresses drought/water-supply relevance; no single bounded physical project selected. Available materials report final strategy and implementation framework. No basin-wide measured adaptation outcome identified. The case is presented as an implementation example, not as evidence that the same results will occur in another place or under different conditions.
